summary: Full audit of the Italserrande PWA at mobile 390, tablet 768 and desktop 1920. AUTH CONSTRAINT: Firebase signUp returns TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_TRY_LATER for this IP, both from REST and from the browser. The admin SDK file firebase-admin.json also fails with 'invalid_grant: Invalid JWT Signature', so I could not create new users. I found a leftover empty test account (testuser+yr1777994990@italserrande.test / TestPassword123!) and used it for every test. Because of this I could NOT run the full 285-test pytest suite: all 33 test files need 2 fresh signups. In its place I wrote and ran a single-user API smoke test: 9/10 pass. RESULTS: (1) I visited all 18 routes at 390 and 1920 with 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors and 0 API responses >=400. No page overflows horizontally; only the area tab bars scroll. (2) Every 'Nuovo' sheet item opens the right form: lavoro → ClientFormDialog on /prossimi-lavori, rilievo → Modulo rilievi, pratica → /documenti?nuova=pratica opens PraticaDialog, contratto → ContrattoDialog, preventivo → creates the quote and opens /preventivi/:id. The Ufficio sheet and the AI FAB sheet also work. (3) UI CRUD end-to-end, checked after reload: lavoro create/edit/delete, appointment date+time via the shadcn calendar, spesa create/delete with the totals updating, contratto create + visit add (next visit recomputed to 20/05/2027) + delete, rilievo create/delete, pratica create/delete, CE/Registro/Verifica delete, preventivo edit/save/PDF/delete, magazzino add. (4) PDFs: I downloaded 24 PDFs via the UI: full pratica (19 pages), all 11 single pratica documents, StampaVuoto for all 6 tipi (18 pages each), Solo CE, Registro, Verifica, Contratto, Rilievo and Preventivo. PyMuPDF check: every multi-page PDF has a correct 'Pagina X di N' on each page, and none contains undefined/NaN/null/$ or odd characters. (5) Assistente: the page loads with the credit box, the 'Bozze di preventivo (0)' empty state and the model picker. 1 short question got a correct answer, cost 'meno di $ 0,01'. (6) The public /impianto/:token page works without login and shows no client data. An invalid token shows 'Impianto non trovato.' (the 404 is expected), and a deleted pratica returns 404. (7) PWA: manifest.json?v=2 returns 200, icons are 192/512/180, and sw.js is registered and active (cache v37). I deleted all test data.

minor.issue: Accepts a payload with no 'name' and returns 200, creating a client with name=''. Cause: models.py:143 _clean_client_nones (mode=before) turns a missing/None name into '' before validation, and ClientCreate inherits it. The frontend guards this (ClientFormDialog.jsx:120), but the API, the offline queue and MCP/AI tools can create nameless clients. Fix: in ClientCreate, add a field_validator('name') that rejects empty strings after strip(), or skip the 'name' default in the before-validator for ClientCreate.

The number of a soft-deleted quote is reused: a new quote got '001' again after quote 001 was deleted. This is acceptable for drafts, but confirm it is intended. Also, the PDF file name is 'Preventivo-1-2026.pdf' while the UI shows 'N° 001'.

ui_bugs.issue: The row is 'flex flex-nowrap justify-end' (ProssimiLavori.jsx:178). At 768px (content width about 448px beside the w-60 sidebar), the 4 labelled buttons overflow to the LEFT: 'Vista settimana' is clipped under the sidebar. Fix: use flex-wrap, or hide the labels below lg.

The extra mobile FAB (Agenda.jsx:496-506, data-testid=add-client-fab, fixed bottom-24 right-5) overlaps the 'ACCONTI OPERAI' card at rest. It also duplicates the central '+' of the bottom nav. Fix: remove it, or add bottom padding to the page so it never covers content.
The selected-theme Check icon (Profilo.jsx:129, absolute right-2 top-2) overlaps the 'Blu Italserrande' label. Fix: add pr-6 to the card text.

issues: Default shadcn <Button> without a bg class renders OLIVE GREEN in the blue theme: credito-aggiungi (CreditoBox.jsx:69), chat-send and chat-confirm (AssistenteChat.jsx:41,168), assistente-copy-url and proposta-approva (Assistente.jsx:34,95). Cause: index.css:47 sets --primary: 76 45% 25% (green), and the blu-italserrande block (index.css:275) overrides only --ring. Fix: add '--primary: 215 100% 34%;' to html[data-theme="blu-italserrande"].

The Ufficio area tabs overflow the max-w content column on desktop: 'Profilo' is cut to 'Profil' at the right edge, and there is no visual scroll hint. On desktop the sidebar already lists every page. Consider wrapping the tabs on md+ (flex-wrap), or hiding AreaTabs when the sidebar is visible.

The 'Pagina 1 di 1' footer (documentiPdf.js:346, y=790.9) sits on the same line as 'Firma del tecnico' (documentiPdf.js:342, y=793.7). The signature row collides with the footer at the bottom margin. Move the signature block up by about 15pt, or the footer down to y≈810.
The footer total is hard-coded: 'Pagina ${page} di 2' (documentiPdf.js:139). It is correct today, but it will be wrong if the content ever grows to 3 pages. Compute it from getNumberOfPages().
The file name 'Dichiarazione-CE-<cliente>.pdf' has no number, unlike the other files ('Registro-Manutenzione-1-...', 'Verbale-verifica-1-...').

Documenti.jsx:66 subtitle 'Dichiarazioni CE e registri di manutenzione, pronti in PDF.' is outdated: the page now also holds Pratiche and Verifiche. The nav label 'Documenti CE' also differs from the page title 'Documenti'.
The Nuovo sheet says 'Nuovo lavoro' but the dialog it opens is titled 'Nuovo cliente' (ClientFormDialog).
Rilievo form labels 'Pezzi No' and 'Oblò No' (SezionaleRilievoDialog.jsx:166,180): in Italian 'No' reads as the negative. Use 'N°' / 'Pezzi (n°)'.
Desktop Agenda empty state says 'Tocca + per aggiungere…' (Agenda.jsx:226), but on desktop the action is the 'Aggiungi' button.

Mobile placeholders are truncated: 'Cerca cliente per nome, indirizzo, telefono…' (client-search-input on /agenda) and 'Cerca per nome o telefono…' (clienti-search-input). Shorten them, e.g. 'Cerca cliente…'.
Da preventivare (mobile): the 'Nuovo preventivo' button and the 'PREVENTIVI · 0 DA GESTIRE' heading wrap to 2 lines in the section header; it looks cramped.
Documenti.jsx:16-17: import statements come after the const TABS declaration. This works, but it is non-standard and linters flag it.
Documenti.jsx:42: GET /documenti errors are swallowed into an empty list, so the user sees 'Nessun documento' instead of an error state.
manifest.json: 'purpose': 'any maskable' on the same icon is discouraged by Chrome/Lighthouse. Provide separate any and maskable icons.

action_items: Blu theme: add --primary: 215 100% 34% to html[data-theme="blu-italserrande"] in index.css so default Buttons (Assistente/CreditoBox) are not olive green
ProssimiLavori.jsx:178: make the actions row wrap (or hide labels) so it does not overflow under the sidebar at 768px
Backend models.py ClientCreate: reject an empty/missing name (POST /api/clients currently returns 200 with name='')
documentiPdf.js:342/346: separate 'Firma del tecnico' from the 'Pagina 1 di 1' footer in the standalone Registro; line 139: compute the CE page total dynamically
Agenda.jsx:496: remove or reposition the redundant mobile FAB that overlaps the Acconti card
Profilo.jsx:129: stop the Check icon overlapping the theme name
AreaTabs on desktop: wrap the tabs or hide them when the sidebar is visible ('Profilo' tab is cut off)
Text fixes: Documenti subtitle, 'Nuovo lavoro' vs 'Nuovo cliente' title, 'Pezzi No'/'Oblò No' → 'N°', desktop 'Tocca +', truncated mobile placeholders
critical_code_review_comments: models.py:143 _clean_client_nones runs on ClientCreate too: the legacy None→'' cleanup also defeats the required 'name' on create
index.css theme overrides use [class~=bg-[#4A5D23]] selectors but do not remap shadcn CSS vars (--primary), so every component that relies on bg-primary ignores the chosen theme
Documenti.jsx: imports after code; the silent catch hides API failures
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/QuoteEditor.jsx (line 212: option label `${v}%` as a single template string; this fixes the dev console error '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in QuoteEditor)
